name: cv
description: A compact, print-friendly curriculum vitae built with Astro

scripts.preview:worker: bun run build && wrangler dev --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: bun run check && bun run build && bun scripts/assert-publishable.mjs && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:dry-run: bun run check && bun run build && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc --dry-run
